name: Phoenix by HG Insights
description: Phoenix by HG Insights gives Claude access to rich B2B technographic and firmographic data, enabling intelligent analysis of technology adoption, competitive intelligence, and market insights. Query detailed data on what technologies companies use, their spending patterns, and firmographic profiles. Phoenix uses agent-based automation to answer complex business questions, helping sales, marketing, and strategy teams make data-driven decisions about target accounts, market sizing, and competitive positioning.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Phoenix by HG Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Phoenix by HG Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://phoenix.hginsights.com/api/ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Phoenix by HG Insights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phoenix by HG Insights lists 15 MCP tools, including company_technographic, company_firmographic, company_search, company_intent, company_spend, company_cloud_spend, company_contracts, company_fai, company_operating_signals, company_install_time_series, company_gov_opportunities, and company_gov_relationships.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Phoenix by HG Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Phoenix by HG Insights in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Phoenix by HG Insights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phoenix by HG Insights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Phoenix by HG Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phoenix by HG Insights is developed by HG Insights. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
